pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SO... IT'S ON HOLD FOR NOW?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: LET ME EXPLAIN FROM THE TOP.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THIS IS THE SAME AS THE CURSED OBJECT YOU ATE.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: TWENTY? OH, COUNTING BOTH FINGERS AND TOES.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IT'S THAT POWERFUL OF A CURSE.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WITH EACH PASSING DAY, THEY GET EVEN STRONGER.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: DOPS, I MADE A HOLE IN THE WALL.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WE ACTUALLY DON'T HAVE ANYONE THAT CAN SEAL THEM PROPERLY RIGHT NOW.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: ...THE CURSE INSIDE YOU, SUKUNA, WILL DIE AS WELL!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THEY'RE MAKING A FUSS ABOUT KILLING YOU RIGHT AWAY.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: BUT THAT WOULD BE A WASTE, RIGHT?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THERE'S NO GUARANTEE THAT A VESSEL CAPABLE OF CONTROLLING SUKUNA WILL EVER COME AROUND AGAIN.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: "IF WE'RE GONNA KILL HIM... ...WHY NOT KILL HIM AFTER HE CONSUMES THE REST OF SUKUNA?"

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: SO NOW YOU HAVE TWO OPTIONS...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: ...AND DIE AFTER TAKING THEM ALL INTO YOUR BODY.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: TAKE IT OFF! TAKE IT OFF!!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THIS IS BAD! IT'S GOING TO BITE ME!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HAHA, YOU SURE SCARE EASY KID~

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: REAL VIPERS ARE ACTUALLY VERY DANGEROUS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF YOU SEE A VIPER OUTSIDE, YOU SHOULD GET OUT OF THERE RIGHT AWAY!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF YOU GET BITTEN, YOU MIGHT END UP LOSING YOUR LIFE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: DO YOU KNOW WHERE SNAKES TEND TO BITE THE MOST?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YES! THEY GO FOR THE FEET!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: A BITE TO THE FEET WILL PUT YOU TO SLEEP, AND THEN YOU MIGHT NEVER SNAKE UP AGAIN!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT'S DANGEROUS EVEN IF YOU ONLY GET A SMALL BITE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF YOU SEE A VIPER, TRY ASKING IF HE'S VENOMOUS!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HE'LL TELL YOU "I MAY BE VENOMOUS, BUT I'VE GOT A GREAT POISONALITY!"

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THERE'S A LOT OF VIPERS ON THE ISLAND.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE OTHER DAY, I WAS WALKING THROUGH THE FOREST WHEN A VIPER SUDDENLY JUMPED OUT IN FRONT OF ME.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AND WHAT DO YOU THINK THE SNAKE DID NEXT?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: FANGFULLY, IT MOVED OUT OF THE WAY!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I DIDN'T EVEN HAVE TO ASP!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT'S NOT JUST KAIDOU, TODAY HAS BEEN FULL OF ANNOYING PEOPLE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WE DON'T ACTUALLY HAVE A LOT OF TIME...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I'LL BE PLAYING IT ON VCR.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THEY'RE NOT GOING TO FIGHT LIVE!?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THAT'S HOW WE USED TO DO IT, BUT NOW THERE ARE ANIMAL PROTECTION LAWS...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: EHH... BUT THEN THE WINNER IS ALREADY PRE-DETERMINED...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT DOESN'T REALLY MATTER, THE MONGOOSE IS STRONGER EVERY TIME.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE FIGHT IS MUCH HARDER FOR THE SNAKE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I'VE BEEN DOING THIS JOB FOR A LONG TIME BUT I'VE NEVER SEEN THE VIPER WIN.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: OKAY, TIME TO START THE VIDEO.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: OH, GOD, YOU GONNA DO ME NOW, PLEASE DON'T--

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: OH, THANK YOU, MAN... OH, I'M SORRY...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: OH SWEET JESUS, THANK YOU, THANK YOU...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I WANT YOU TO GET UP... AND I WANT YOU TO WALK AWAY.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AND LET ME EXPLAIN SOMETHING BEFORE YOU GO.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU'RE OUT OF HERE. FOR GOOD.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SEE YOU AROUND, HEAR YOU AROUND...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: YOU GOTTA FORGIVE US, BOSS! WE AIN'T GONNA EVER--

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IS IT TRYING TO SWALLOW THE CURSED OBJECT AND THE STUDENTS ALL AT ONCE?

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: NO ONE WENT TO SEE HIM BESIDES ME.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I THINK YOU DIED PEACEFULLY, GRANDPA.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE GUY LYING FACE-DOWN IS HIS BODYGUARD.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THIS IS THE THIRD CASE THIS YEAR IN OUR JURISDICTION ALONE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: 'COURSE, THEIR HANDS WERE PRETTY BLOODY TO BEGIN WITH.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: OTHER PEOPLE'S LIVES DIDN'T MEAN A THING TO THEM...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...BUT THEIR OWN, THEY HAD A PRETTY HIGH OPINION OF.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I THINK CHARLIE HAS THE LIST...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE FIRST WAS ON JANUARY THE FIFTH. RICHARD BACH, AGED 45. LIVED ON EAST 152ND.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SHOT HIMSELF IN THE RIGHT TEMPLE WITH A .380 WAD-CUTTER.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IN THE SECOND CASE, THE IMPORTER -- ALSO UNDER INVESTIGATION FOR SMUGGLING. THIS TIME THERE WERE WITNESSES WHO SAW HIM JUMP OUT HIS APARTMENT WINDOW... RIGHT IN THE MIDDLE OF A FAMILY DINNER.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AND NOW JERRY WATTS. SLITS HIS OWN THROAT WITH A STRAIGHT RAZOR!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: JUMPING OUT A WINDOW... GUNSHOT TO THE HEAD... ORTHODOX SUICIDE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: NO, NOT MUCH ROOM FOR SUSPICION.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SAY YOU'RE ACTUALLY HARDCORE ENOUGH TO GO BY CUTTING YOUR OWN THROAT. BUT YOU'VE GOT A BODYGUARD. WELL, SIMPLE WAY WOULD BE IN THE JOHN. WHEN THE KNOCK COMES ON THE DOOR, TEN MINUTES LATER, TUB'S FULL.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: BUT OUR MR. WATTS... FOR SOME REASON, HE LIKED THINGS COMPLICATED. FOR HE FELT THE NEED TO SNEAK UP BEHIND HIS BODYGUARD... AND TAKE THE GOOD TIME AND TROUBLE TO CUT HIS THROAT FIRST.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: READ IT AND YOU'LL FIND IT THAT MUCH HARDER TO BELIEVE HE'D COMMIT SUICIDE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: BEAT THE RAP ON A FRAUD COUNT THREE TIMES.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HE SAID "I WILL BE RETURNING THE BOOK I BORROWED, SO TELL ME A CONVENIENT TIME."

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...THOUGH IT'S FINE NOT TO DO IT PERSONALLY, SINCE WE'RE ALL BUSY.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: YOU HAVE A MESSAGE FROM SPECIAL CLASS ARIMA.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: JEEZ, IS HE BEING CONSCIENTIOUS, OR NANT...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: AH, THAT "NANT" CAN HAVE ANOTHER "NAN" IN IT...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HE WANTS TO MEET YOU AFTER SUCH A LONG WHILE, DOESN'T HE?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I WONDER IF THAT GUY HAS THAT SORT OF FEELING...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I'LL TRY GOING OVER THERE WHEN THE INVESTIGATION CALMS DOWN.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THE TRUE POWER WHICH HAS RECEIVED THE WHITE WING MEDAL IS NOT JUST FOR SHOW.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I AM ALSO HOPING YOU'LL BE THE MADO SQUAD'S ACE.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: HOW ABOUT I STRIVE FOR A HUG?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: DID YOU DROP BY SHIBA-SENSEI'S PLACE?

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: MY ANEMIA WAS ACTING UP AGAIN...

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: THERE WAS AN INCIDENT OF "GROWLING SOUNDS OF A BEAST" BEING HEARD FROM THE NEIGHBORHOOD.

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: AND THE LADY WAS WORRIED THAT "IT MIGHT BE A GHOUL"...

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: BUT, AS A RESULT OF RANK 3 YONEBAYASHI AND I INVESTIGATING AROUND THE AREA,

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: WE ASCERTAINED THAT IN TRUTH IT WAS JUST A STRAY DOG,

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: THAT HAD MADE THE NEIGHBORHOOD ITS HOME, GROWLING BEHIND THE LADY'S HOUSE.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: So it was just a beast.

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: WHEN WE INFORMED THE LADY OF THAT SHE SAID "FROM TODAY ON, I'LL BE ABLE TO SLEEP SOUNDLY"

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHO'S EVER SEEN ME LIKE THIS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SO I CAN'T ASK ANYONE ELSE.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: LET'S START BY HAVING YOU TOUCH HIM WITH YOUR BARE HANDS.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: YOU ALMOST CAN'T IMAGINE EATING HIM.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT WON'T BITE OFF MY FINGER?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: DO YOU THINK ALL FISH ARE PIRANHAS?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I'M SEEING A WHOLE DIFFERENT SIDE OF YOU NOW...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THAT'S NOT SO SCARY, IS IT?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I'M TRYING MY BEST TO NOT JUST CAUSE PROBLEMS...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT SEEMS NONE OF THE OTHERS EXCEPT THE "SQUAD LEADER" HAVE COME TO HAVE THEIR BLOOD DRAWN?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: EVERYONE IS GOING AT THEIR OWN PACE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE SQUAD LEADER AND SHIRAZU-KUN ARE BOTH ON INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATIONS, AREN'T THEY...?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I WONDER IF SAIKO-CHAN... OVERSLEPT AGAIN...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: EVEN THOUGH SENSEI TOLD EVERYONE TO COOPERATE...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WELL, BUT, EVEN IF I TELL THEM THEY WON'T LISTEN TO ME ANYHOW...

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: THOSE GUYS ARE OUR, THE HIRAKO SQUAD'S, RIVALS?

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: I DON'T WANT THEM LOOKING DOWN ON US.

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: NOW, NOW, I TOLD YOU "PLEASE GET ALONG", SINCE THEY ARE OUR COMRADES.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: THEY ARE A SCARY SQUAD IN "SEVERAL WAYS"...

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: I DON'T KNOW WHAT THE HIGHER UPS ARE THINKING.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: CONSIDERING ALL THE FANFARE WHEN IT WAS ESTABLISHED,

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: IT SEEMS LIKE IT ISN'T GOING TO PRODUCE ANY RESULTS AT ALL.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I... I'VE BEEN LISTENING TO YOU FOR YEARS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT'S ALL I EVER GET OUT OF YOU.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: BUT I NEVER KNOW WHAT IT MEANS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: NOT WHEN HE SAID IT EITHER.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AND YOU SAY IT AND YOU MIGHT AS WELL BE DEAD.
